title: Asscher Solitaire Ring
descriptionHtml:
One square of stepped light. A single Asscher cut clear cubic zirconia, about 8mm across, its cut corners and stepped facets drawing the eye down into the stone, held high in four slim gold claws on a plain polished band. It adjusts to fit US 5 to 8.

STYLING TIP: Wear it alone, or stack it beside the Pavé Zigzag Ring.

Details

  • Size: Adjustable, fits US 5 to 8
  • Stone: Asscher cut clear cubic zirconia, approximately 8mm
  • Setting: Four slim gold claws
  • Band: Plain polished, approximately 2mm
  • Finish: Polished gold tone

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
